text: You just got access to a Hub MCP. It is a secure bridge that lets your AI app use approved tools. You get your own lane, Hub URL, and approved host. The bearer token is the key that goes into your host, not your portal login. In this example, the host is Codex. Paste the Hub URL and token into the host config. Claude Desktop and Cursor follow the same pattern. Start with one safe question. What tools do I have access to in this Hub? First, search. Then inspect. Then run the approved action. Safe actions run fast. Risky actions ask for review. Blocked actions stop with a clear reason. If the connection breaks, do not guess. Check the connection. Ask for the repair link. Reconnect. Retry the same action. Connect once. Start with one safe workflow. Ask for review when the system tells you to.
